away.name: Dan Vladar
away.news: After a dreadful 0-6-3 start to the season, the Flyers are riding a two-game winning streak and will try to keep the vibes positive on Wednesday with Vladar between the pipes. Vladar has battled adversity this season, posting an ugly 3.58 GAA and .889 SV% in five games (1-3-1), but he's played better recently. The 29-year-old Czech goalie has a 1.44 GA and .947 SV% in his last two games (1-0-1). The Flyers enter Wednesday's contest as +164 road underdogs against a 4-3-2.

home.name: Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen
home.news: With Alex Lyon (upper body) still sidelined, the Sabres have relied heavily on Luukkonen, who has provided mixed results early on. Luukkonen has an ugly 3.59 GAA and .860 SV% through seven games (3-2-2). That said, despite the ugly numbers, the 27-year-old Finnish goalie has done enough to help his team get points in four straight (2-0-2), posting a 3.24 GAA and .897 SV%. The Sabres enter Wednesday's contest as -181 home favourites against a 2-6-3 Philadelphia Flyers team on a two-game winning streak.

away.name: Akira Schmid
away.news: With Jacob Markstrom (upper body) on Injured Reserve, Florida will likely lean heavily on Schmid. Schmid was already seeing a decent workload, even with Markstrom in the lineup, starting four of nine games. The 26-year-old Swiss goalie has a 2-1-1 record, a 3.25 GAA, and an .878 SV%. The Panthers enter Wednesday's contest as slight -107 road favourites against an Ottawa Senators team that has scored two or fewer goals in five of their last six games (4-2-0).

home.name: Linus Ullmark
home.news: Ullmark has been excellent this season, but is coming off his first loss despite another strong outing, saving 25 of 27 shots (.926 SV%) in a 3-1 loss to the Philadelphia Flyers. The 33-year-old Swedish goalie is 6-1-0 with a stellar 1.33 GAA and .945 SV% this season. The Senators enter a highly anticipated Wednesday-night game against their former captain, Brady Tkachuk, and the Florida Panthers, who are riding a three-game winning streak.
